name: S&P 500 regime reclaim + crypto momentum — equity-beta continuation (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why equities lead crypto): the S&P 500 is the global risk-on benchmark and crypto carries a positive beta to broad equities. When the SPX reclaims a level (crosses UP through a fitted regime line), the macro risk-on switch has flipped, and high-beta crypto tends to follow and amplify the move. Equities, being the deeper, faster-repricing market, lead the regime turn that crypto then rides. We trigger on spx_index cross_up (a discrete regime reclaim — used deliberately because the raw index level is non-stationary) AND positive crypto ret_Nd (own-beta confirming), and exit when SPX crosses back down (regime lost). DISCONFIRMER 1: if crypto momentum alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the SPX gate adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (PIT): the daily index close is knowable next-day — if the edge needs same-session SPX it is look-ahead. DISCONFIRMER 3: in stress, crypto's beta to SPX spikes toward 1 and the 'lead' collapses to coincident — the regime filter must add timing beyond that. tier0 macro; low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: spx_index crosses UP through a fitted regime level (equities reclaiming risk-on) while crypto momentum is positive.
